postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip(input_values[0::2], input_values[1::2]))
postconditions.description: Each string s has length n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i < r_i <= n for l_i, r_i in zip(input_values[2::2], input_values[3::2]))
postconditions.description: Each pair of indices (l_i, r_i) is a valid substring range.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[i] == 'YES' if any(s[l_i-1:r_i] in [''.join(seq) for seq in itertools.permutations(s, r_i-l_i+1) if not all(c == s[k] for k, c in enumerate(seq)) and len(seq) > 1] for s in input_values[1::2]) else 'NO' for i, (l_i, r_i) in enumerate(zip(input_values[2::2], input_values[3::2])))
postconditions.description: For each query, output 'YES' if there exists a good subsequence equal to the substring s[l_i...r_i], and 'NO' otherwise.
